Name: CASE Tractor Mod Recolor.
Author: Master2873
Description:
A basic recolor of the tractor from the Tractor Mod to make it looks like a CASE tractor.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png[/img]﻿

-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url]﻿


[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]﻿

- After installing Tractor Mod, navigate to, Stardew Valley/Mods/ Tractor Mod/Assets
- To make it your main tractor, simply rename the file to "[code]tractor.png[/code]", or make it a seasonal texture if you wish with this example, "[code]spring_tractor.png[/code]" (or any other season you wish for.).
- This will override the current tractor design included with Tractor Mod! So, make sure to back it up!!!

Downloads.Description: Basic recolor of the tractor from the Tractor Mod. Be sure to follow instructions for it to work properly.
